༄༅/ /lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs kyi rol mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs kyi rol mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// na maḥshri mansaṅgu ra we/ lhag bsam dag pa'i cha shas yongs gang zhing*// gzhan phan du ma'i gsil zer 'od ldan pas| /smon 'jug kun da'i tshal rab rgyas byed pa'i// dpal ldan bla ma mtshan mo'i mgon por 'dud// 'dir mdo rgyud man ngag thams cad kyi yang rtse grub thob rnams kyi gdams ngag tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas thob par byed pa'i lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig gzhan la phan pa'i phyir bri bar bya'o// nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya// de'i ched du lam zab mo bla "$ ma'i rnal 'byor zhu snyam pa'i ngang nas nyan/ de yang lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de kho na nyid de dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i dus thabs brten pa dang*/ rang gi bsod nams kho na las rkyen gzhan gyis brjod pa dang rtogs par byed pa ma yin te| brtag gnyis las/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus mtha' brten pa dang*// rang gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes dang*/ ā li kā li chu klung chen po'i rgyud las/ brjod bral lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de// tshogs bsags sgrib pa sbyangs pa'i lag rjes dang*// rtogs ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs ma gtogs pa// thabs gzhan bsten pa'i rmongs pas rnyed par dka'// zhes pas/ bla ma dam pa ma bsten na yon tan ci yod kyang srid pa'i mthar mi bgrod de/ ye shes grub pa las/ skya ba 'dzin pa med par ni// gru yi pha rol phyin mi 'gyur// de bzhin yon tan kun rdzogs kyang*// bla ma med na srid mthar min| /zhes gsungs pas/ mtshan ldan gyi bla ma dam pa sten pa gal che ste/ 'phags pa brgyad stong pa las/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas/ dang po nyid du dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsten par bya/

bsnyen bkur bar bya'o// zhes pa dang*/ sdud pa las/ slob ma bzang po bla mar gus ldan de dag gis/ bla ma mkhas pa rnams la nye bar bsten par bya/ ci phyir zhe na mkhas pa'i yon tan de las 'byung*// zhes pa dang*/ mnga' bdag mai tri pas/ bla ma rje btsun ma bsten na/ dngos grub rnam gnyis thob mi srid// ces dang*/ rje 'gro ba'i mgon pos// rgyu yi gtso bo yin pas mtshan ldan bla ma 'tshol// zhes gsungs/ mtshan ldan gyi bla ma bsten na yon tan thams cad 'byung ba yin te/ bla ma la gus yod gyur na// 'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// bla ma la gus med gyur na// bsgrubs kyang 'grub par mi 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ 'phags pa brgyad stong pa las/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi yongs su zin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o// zhes dang*/ sdud pa las/ sangs rgyas chos rnams dge ba'i bshes la bsten to zhes// yon tan kun gyi mchog mnga' rgyal ba de skad gsung*// zhes gsungs// 'o na bla ma mtshan nyid ji lta bu dang ldan pa zhig dgos zhe na// bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ yang dag shes shing rgyud shes pa// dpal ldan khrag 'thung gsang sngags shes| /khro med gtsang zhing mkhas pa dang*// sbyor shes ye shes pha rol 'gro// zhes dang*/ brtag gnyis las/ rang 'dod lha mnyam rnal 'byor pa// rab mthong sngags kyi pha rol son| /zhes pa dang*/ dus 'khor bsdus rgyud las/ dang por yang dag bsten bya bla ma dag kyang dam tshig ldan zhing rdo rje theg la lhag par gnas/ de nyid bsgom zhing ma chags dri ma dag dang rnam par bral zhing bzod pa'i ngang tshul lam la zhugs// slob ma rnams la lam ni sbyin byed dmyal ba'i 'jigs pa 'phrog cing de nyid la ni tshangs spyod ldan// bdud rnams la ni rdo rje dbyug pa de yang 'dzin ma'i gzhi la rdo rje sems dpar grags/

zhes dang*/ sdom 'byung las/ zhi zhing dul ba'i cha lugs can// sems can kun rab mi 'jigs ster/ sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes// bstan bcos rig cing snying rjer ldan// sems can kun la bu bzhin blta// zhes mtshan nyid rgyas par gsungs shing*/ gur las/ nyan thos spyod pa skyong byed cing*| /de nyid bcu ni yongs shes shing*// zhes mtshan nyid bco brgyad gsungs shing*/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rgya che the tshom spong ba dang*// gzung 'os de nyid gnyis ston pa// 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' yi// ston pa phun tshogs yin zhes bya// zhes dang*/ yang*/ bshes gnyen dul ba zhi ba nyer zhi ba// yon tan lhag par brtson byas lung gis phyug /ces dang*| byang sa las/ de la rnam pa brgyad dang ldan na/ byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnam pa thams cad rdzogs pa yin par rig par bya ste/ brgyad gang zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims dang ldan pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod mang du thos pa dang*/ rtogs pa dang ldan pa dang*/ rjes su snying brtse ba dang ldan pa dang*| mi 'jigs pa dang ldan pa dang*/ yid yongs su mi skyo ba yin pa dang*/ tshig gi bya ba dang ldan pa'o// zhes dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ rtag par dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni// theg chen don la mkhas pa dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i brtul zhugs mchog /srog gi phyir yang mi gtong ngo*// zhes dang*/ bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ brtan zhing dul la blo gros ldan| /bzod ldan drang la g.yo rgyu med// sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes// snying brtser ldan zhing bstan bcos mkhas// de nyid bcu ni yongs su shes// dkyil 'khor bri ba'i las la mkhas| /sngags bshad pa yi spyod pa shes// rab tu zhi zhing dbang po dul// zhes gsungs pas/ mdor na/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa bcos ma ma yin pa/ zab gsal lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon sum du ngo sprod par byed pa rtogs pa don gyi dbang mchog sems la bskur bas// snang srid sku gsum gyi rgyal srid la dbang bsgyur ba'i brgyud ba zam ma chad pas dbang gis chu bo gzhung ma nyams tshul de lta bu la bsten nas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob cing thun mong gi dngos grub zhar la brnyes pa sha stag pas dngos grub kyi rgya mtsho kha ma bri/

sems nyid yid bzhin gyi nor bu la byi dor byas pas dgos 'dod mtha' dag sems la 'grub pa'i brgyud pa ma nyams pas rtogs pa'i nor bu 'od ma yal// snyan brgyud zab mo la tshong 'dus kyi 'o ma bzhin gzhan gyi bsre lhad kyi dbang du ma song zhing man ngag zab mo'i nying khu ltar gdams pa'i bdud rtsi bcud ma nyams pa dang ldan pa'i brgyud ldan gyi bla ma zhig dgos te/ rje btsun nā ro bas| bla ma'i mtshan nyid brgyud par ldan// zhes dang*/ grub thob gling gis/ shes rab chen pos chos nyid bden pa'i don rtogs pa/ snying rje chen pos gzhan gyi sdug bsngal mi bzod pa| byin rlabs chen pos gzhan gyi snang ba bsgyur nus pa/ gdam ngag chen pos gzhan gyi brgyud la yon tan 'khod nus pa/ nyams myong chen pos gzhan gyi lam sna 'khrid nus pa/ zhes dang*| rje gtsang pas/ rtogs pas bdag grol ba/ thugs rjes gzhan grol ba/ rten 'brel thabs la mkhas pa/ 'brel tshad don dang ldan pa// zhes gsungs pas mtshan nyid de rnams dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa de dkon mchog gsum gyi bdag nyid yin te/ phyogs bcu rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse mdzad pa ji snyed pa'i ngo bor gyur pas sangs rgyas| zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas yin pas chos/ rig pa dang grol bar smra ba'i 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag yin pas dge 'dun te/ ji skad du bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te// kun gyi byed po bla ma yin// zhes gsungs shing*/ yang bla ma'i ngo bo chos kyi sku yin te/ rje gling gis/ bla ma'i ngo bo chos kyi sku// rdo rje 'chang dang zhal mjal bas// brgyud pa nye ring bgrang ma dgos/ zhes dang*/ bdag gi yongs 'dzin dam pa'i zhal snga nas/ rje mtshan ldan bla ma chos kyi sku// mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i rin po che// zhes gsungs/

de lta bu'i bla ma dam pa la gsol ba ma btab na byin rlabs mi 'jug byin rlabs ma zhugs na tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas mi thob pas gsol ba 'debs pa gal che ste/ ye shes mkha' 'gro mas/ grub thob u rgyan pa la gsungs pa/ e ma ho/ gson dang skal ldan rnal 'byor pa// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub de// rang rtsa ba'i bla ma ma gtogs pa// don logs nas rnyed par cang gda' 'am// sems rnal du phobs la gsol ba thob// ces gsungs shing*/ bla ma la gsol ba btab na// sdug bsngal dang nyes pa thams cad 'dag byed gzhan la ma ltos par de nyid kyis sa lam thams cad thogs pa med par bgrod de myur du mchog gi dngos grub thob pa yin te| rje btsun nā ro pas/ kun la bla ma'i rnal 'byor shis// ci dgu thams cad bla ma la// gsol ba btab las 'byung bar 'dug /ces gsungs pas/ gsol ba ji ltar 'debs zhe na| spyod 'jug las/ nyam thag nga ros 'o dod 'bod// sdig ldan bdag la thugs rjes gzigs// zhes dang*/ 'gro ba'i mgon pos bla ma mtho ste yar la bstod// rang re dma' ste mar la smad// ces dang*/ yang*/ gdong mchi mas gang zhing gsol ba thob// brgyal 'dre log log gsol ba thob/ khyod ci nyes zhes pa'i gsol ba thob// ces dang*/ rje la gsol ba 'debs nus na// chos mi shes kyang 'di kas chog /sgom mi shes kyang 'di kas chog /bsrung ba drag sngags kyang 'di kas chog /ces dang*/ rgyal dbang rjes/ bla ma la mchog gi 'du shes dang*/ bdag la dman pa'i 'du shes rab tu bskyed la/ bla ma'i yon tan rnams rjes su dran pa'i tshul dang*/ bdag gi skyon 'tshang rnams ngos 'dzin cing 'dor bar 'dod ba'i bsam pas/ snying thag pa nas gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ zhes dang*/ yang*/ gtan kyi skyabs gnas bla ma yin pas/ gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas btab na/ byin rlabs thugs kyi dkyil nas 'jug pa ni dga' rang dga'/ zhes gsungs pas/

sgom lugs ni/ spyi bo'i gtsug gam lag pa'i mthil// snying gi dkyil du sus bsgoms pa// sangs rgyas stong gi yon tan kyang*// gang zag de yi 'dzin par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ ring brgyud khrom tshogs su bsgom pa/ nye brgyud mtho brtsegs su bsgom pa| kun 'dus nor bu lugs su bsgom pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dpag bsam shing gi sdong po/ rtsa ba gcig la yal ga du mar gyes pa'i dbus su/ gyad dang seng ge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i khar padma dang zla ba nyi ma brtsegs pa'i steng du/ lha'i gos rin thang med pa du mas klubs pa'i gdan la/ ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam pa rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu snol thabs su 'dzin pa/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo dga' ba'i rnam par 'gyur bas dgyes shing gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor pa/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes shing*/ gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu dang ldan pa/ thugs ji lta ba ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes lnga dang ldan pa/ phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i bdag nyid can du gsal ba la/ tshig brgyud/ don brgyud| sgrub brgyud/ bka' brgyud/ snyan brgyud kyi bla ma thams cad dang*/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa/ yi dam lha tshogs/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pa thams cad rtsa ba gcig la yal ga du mar 'phros pa'i tshul gyis/ sprin gyi phung po 'khrigs pa ltar mkha' khyab tu bzhugs par bsam/ gnyis pa ni/ rang lus tha mal gyi snang zhen log par bya ba'i ched du snang la rang bzhin med pa'i yi dam gyi lha rjes su dran par byas pa'i rigs bdag gi tshul du rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang du gsal btab pa'i dbu thog na yar la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams mu tig ltar la brgyus pa ltar mtho brtsegs su bzhugs pa dmigs la/

de dag kyang ngo bo chos kyi skur gcig pa/ rnam pa gang la gang 'dul gyi tshul du tha dad par snang ba/ brtse bas gdul bya thams cad la dmigs pa med pa 'jug par mdzad pa/ dgos 'dod thams cad yid bzhin du rtsol ba la mthu thogs pa med pa mnga' ba kho na'i rang bzhin du bsam/ gsum pa ni/ rang yi dam lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri/ padma dang*/ zla ba dang*/ dar gyis klubs pa'i gdan la drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku mdog ind+ra nī la'i mdangs can/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs la dar sna lnga'i thod bcings pa rin po che'i dbu rgyan| mgul rgyan/ phyag gdub zhabs gdub se mo do la sogs pas brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ sku lta bas chog mi shes pa/ gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu dang ldan pa/ thugs ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen par gsal ba la/ phyogs bcu nas rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsrung ma nam mkha' gang bar byon pa thams cad bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bor gyur pa'i sku gsung thugs dang gnyis su med par gyur de ltar gsal btab pa la/ mchod pa 'bul ba gal che ste/ sdom 'byung las/ mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs te// bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsam// zhes gsungs pas/ bla ma mchod pa gal che bas/ mchod pa la phyi'i mchod pa/ nang gi mchod pa/ gsang ba'i mchod pa/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa las/ dang po ni/ bdag gi lus kyang nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rdul snyed du sprul te/ grangs ji snyed du phyag 'tshal ba'i yan lag nas brtsams te thams cad mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ rang gi lus longs spyod gling bzhi ri rab sogs brtan pa'i dngos po ji snyed 'bul ba phyi'i mchod pa/

gzugs mdzes pa/ sgra snyan pa/ ro mngar ba/ reg bya 'jam pa la sogs pa'i dngos po 'bul ba nang gi mchod pa/ sgeg sogs brgyad| rig ma bcu drug la sogs pa gsang ba'i mchod pa/ de dag las byung ba'i bde ba dang stong pa de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa 'bul ba'i dgos pa ni/ sdom 'byung las/ de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen pa'i// ye shes mchog ni thob par 'gyur// zhes pa dang*/ bla med mdzad pa'i slob dpon ni/ rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod na// de yi bsod nams ma byas shing*// dka' thub ma bsten ci zhig yod// 'jigs dang sdig pa spang ba dang*// bde ba dang ni ldan pa nyid// ces gsungs shing*/ gsol ba ring rdzogs su 'debs pa ni| brgyud pa 'di'i lugs kyi sku lnga rab rdzogs dang*/ pho nya myur mgyogs zhes bya ba'i gsol 'debs kyi tshig rnams su 'byung ba ltar byed cing*/ mos pa gtso che ba'i sgo nas ji tsam rigs par spel te gsol ba 'debs pa'i rim ba rnams yin no// thung rdzogs su gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ de yang spyir 'khor 'das kyi phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi drin las byung zhing*/ snga ma snga ma'i byin rlabs dang rtogs pa dang thugs rje las/ phyi ma phyi ma 'byung bar shes pa dang*/ rgyu mtshan de dag gi bde dge dang legs tshogs thams cad rtsa ba'i bla ma la rag las par mthong nas/ so so rang rang gi mtshan brjod nas/ gus pa'i lus/ snyan pa'i ngag dang ba'i yid rnams rtse gcig tu byas te| phyag rgya chen po/ chos drug la sogs pa'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang*/ kun 'dus nor bu lugs ltar na/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad snying khongs su bcug ste/ kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par sems rgyud dang 'dre nges pa'i sgo nas ngag tu yang*/ sku bzhi'i gsol 'debs bzhi skor dang 'brel ba'i tshig 'gro mgon gtsang pas mdzad pa'i ma lus kun khyab ma dang*/

mnyam med rgod tshang pas mdzad pa'i byin rlabs kyi tshan kha shin tu che ba bla ma sangs rin mar grags pa bya zhing*/ de dag gi rjes su// ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la skyabs su mchi'o// bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i= bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku la= bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la= sems can thams cad kyi blo chos su 'gro bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ chos lam du 'gro bar= lam 'khrul pa sel bar= 'khrul pa ye shes su 'char bar= rtogs pas bdag grol bar= thugs rjes gzhan grol bar= rten 'brel thabs la mkhas par= 'brel tshad don dang ldan par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas brgyud pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ yi dam lha tshogs/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsrung ma rnams rtsa ba'i bla ma yab yum la thim/ bla ma yab yum rang gi spyi bor spyan drangs/ bla ma'i sku'i smin mtshams nas 'od zer dkar po dri ma med pa skar mda'i tshul du breng ma chad par byung ste/ bdag nyid kyi smin mtshams su thim pas| lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang*/ lus tha mal du 'dzin pa'i dri ma snyigs ma zag bcas kyi phung po'i sgrib pa thams cad dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ lam bskyed rim sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku thob pa'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ yang bla ma yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems khams dkar dmar gcig tu 'dres pa'i ngo bor gyur ba'i 'od zer dmar po dri ma med pa byung nas rang gi lce thog tu babs pas/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab gang bas/ ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sgrib pa dang*/ ngag tha mal du 'dzin pa'i dri ma dag rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam par rtog pa thams cad kyi rten byed pa'i las rlung gi rgyu ba nyi khri chig stong drug brgya dbyings su dag ste/

lam rtsa rlung thig le sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob pa'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ bla ma yab yum kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer kha dog sngon po skar mda'i tshul du breng ma chad par byung nas snying gar thim pas/ snying ga'i rtsa 'dab kyi dbus na rnam par shes pa'i rten mi shigs pa'i thig le dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad bde ba dang stong pa gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo dang ro gcig tu gyur/ des yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang*/ yid tha mal du 'dzin pa'i dri ma dang phyin ci log tu 'dzin pa'i sgrib pa dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ pho nya'i lam sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku thob pa'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ bla ma yab yum 'od du zhu nas bdag nyid la thim pas bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum chu la chu bzhag pa ltar dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres/ sgo gsum tha mal lam tha dad du 'dzin pa'i dri ma dag de kho na nyid la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa drungs nas phyung ste/ dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che thob/ chos thams cad chu dang rlabs lta bur sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sku gsum ngo bo gcig tu gyur pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas/ thun rdzogs kyi dus su brgyud pa'i bla ma gong ma gong ma rnams 'og ma la rim gyis thim/ mthar rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i dpral ba nas 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rang gi dpral bar thim/ lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ lam bskyed rim sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sku rdo rje sprul pa'i sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas/ bla ma'i mgrin pa nas 'od zer dmar po dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rang gi mgrin par thim/ ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa dag

gsang ba'i dbang thob/ lam rtsa rlung thig le sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer sngon po dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rang gi snying gar thim/ yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa dag pho nya'i lam sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu thugs rdo rje chos kyi sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dag dbang bzhi pa thob/ lam phyag rgya chen po sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ye shes rdo rje ngo bo nyid kyi sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'o// kun 'dus kyi dus su bla ma 'od du zhu nas/ bla ma dang rang gi sems nyid gnyis gcig tu 'dres pa la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa kho na ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang gi don yin zhing*/ dbang don ji snyed cig bshad pa de thams cad kyang tshul lugs 'di las mi 'da' ba'i phyir ro// bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du bsres pa'i ngang la 'das pa'i rjes mi dpyad/ ma 'ongs pa'i sngun mi bsu/ da ltar gyi snang ba yid la mi bya bar shes pa gsal la rtog pa med pa/ nam mkha' rnam par dag pa'i dkyil lta bu'i ngang du sems ma bcos par rang gar rtsen gyis bzhag pa de'i dus su shes pa skad cig ma gcig gam gnyis tsam gnas yod pa de yun ring ba la yon tan du mi lta/ thung ba la skyon du mi lta bar bsgoms bas dus re zhig tsa na/ shes pa de mar me'i rtse mo'am/ chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du 'khril gyis 'gro ba yin/ de'i dus su ngo bo phyogs ris med cing spros pa thams cad dang bral ba rang bzhin gsal la go ma 'gags pa ngos gzung med pa de mtshan nyid/

rtog pa sna tshogs su 'gyur ba de skye ba med par rtogs/ 'gag pa med par rtogs pas mtha' dang bral ba nam mkha' ltar yangs pa de lta ba/ nyams myong gzung du med pa nyi zla ltar gsal ba de sgom pa/ dran snang chos nyid du shar ba de spyod pa/ de lta bu nyams su myong ba de 'bras bu/ de las skyo na bsngo ba smon lam gyi rgyas 'debs gal pa gar che ste/ smon lam dpag med 'debs pa ni// 'gro don phal gyi do zla min// zhes gsungs pas/ dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /dpal ldan bla ma 'grub gyur nas// zhes pa'i bsdo ba smon lam la 'bad cing*/ de ltar sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi skya bar nas bton nas sgom zhing*/ mos gus la bstan pa thob na/ ye shes la bstan pa thob pa de la rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa zer te/ gling gcig la dum bu bcu gsum du chad pa na de dag rim gyis thob pa'i dbang du byas/ sa bcu gsum bgrod pa'i tha snyad kyang gling gi mthar thug pa ni/ de dag thams cad gling gcig tu 'dres pa ltar/ rtogs pa gcig gis sa lam ma lus bgrod// ces gsungs pa bzhin sa lam stan thog gcig tu rdzogs pa'i rim pa yin pas/ de tsam zhig la chos 'brel mdzod/ ces pa 'di bla ma bsam gtan gter mdzod dang*/ grub chen shākya'i mtshan can gyi rigs dbon bla ma rgya mtsho dang*/ dge slong chos mchog rgyal po rnams kyis bskul ba'i dor// dpal ldan sgrub brgyud rin po che'i ring lugs dri ma med pa 'dzin pa/ shākya'i dge slong ngag dbang kun dga' rnam rgyal nor bu dpal bzang pos/ rgyal dbang rje dang*/ yongs 'dzin dag gi dbang po'i gsung ngag rgyud sde dang*/ bka' brgyud rin po che rnams kyi lung gis brgyan te/ gdan sa chen po ra lung thel gyi yang dgon chos kyi mtho ba'i khang bzang gi 'dab/ kun dga' ra ba chos kyi 'byung gnas gang shar bde chen du bris pa'i yi ge pa'ang*/ bla ma bstan pa rgya mtshos bgyis pa'i dge bas sems can thams cad kyis rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob cing*/
kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ/// /
